title: DIN-rail clip
about: a snap-on clip for 35 mm DIN rail with a fixed hook, a springy catch and M3 inserts, its arm strain kept as a param
tries: Make the clip 60 mm wide with four inserts on a 50 × 20 mm pattern | Add a pull tab under the catch so it releases without a screwdriver

agent.role: a control-panel designer who makes printed snap fits that survive many cycles
agent.prompt: Prefer checking a snap arm by its strain 1.5·t·δ/L² against the material (PETG 0.04, PLA 0.02); print springy parts so they bend within their layers; never let a hook reach more than 2.5 mm behind a DIN flange.

fragments.rail: TS35 × 7.5 rail: edges 35 mm apart, flanges 1 mm thick, 7.5 mm off the panel; TS35 × 15 is deeper but the same at the flanges.
fragments.strain: Keep strain as a param and read it after every change to the arm.
